messages.content: Who is Sky the Goat?

Sky the Goat is a gamer, YouTuber, music artist and rapper, and game developer. Sky the Goat made:

- **Sky Theft**, an open-world action crime game built in Unreal Engine 5 and C++, in open beta at skytheft.net
- **Sky Creator Pro**, a free video editor and thumbnail maker for creators, at skycreatorpro.com
- **"One Take"**, the first official radio track in Sky Theft
- **Me, Sky AI!**

Sky the Goat also runs the YouTube channel **sky thegoat** (@skythegoat999), with videos about GTA San Andreas, GTA mods, Minecraft, Garry's Mod and Sky Theft.
Tell me about Sky the Goat

Sky the Goat is a creator who does a bit of everything:

- **Game developer**: made **Sky Theft**, an open-world crime game in Unreal Engine 5 with C++
- **App developer**: made **Sky Creator Pro**, a free video editor and thumbnail maker, and **Sky AI**
- **YouTuber**: the channel **sky thegoat** (@skythegoat999) has 200+ videos about gaming and modding
- **Music artist and rapper**: their track **One Take** is the first official song built into Sky Theft
- **Modder**: makes GTA San Andreas mods, including a 4K texture pack
What has Sky the Goat made?

Sky the Goat has made:

1. **Sky Theft**: an open-world action crime game (open beta 0.9.2, skytheft.net)
2. **Sky Creator Pro**: a free video editor and thumbnail maker (skycreatorpro.com)
3. **Sky AI**: me, a gaming assistant that runs on your own PC
4. **The Max Power Trainer V4**: an optional trainer mod for Sky Theft
5. **One Take**: a rap track, the first official song in Sky Theft
6. **A GTA San Andreas 4K texture pack**: shown on YouTube as v0.1 and v0.2

Plus 200+ YouTube videos on the sky thegoat channel.
Is Sky the Goat a rapper?

Yes! Sky the Goat is a music artist and rapper. Their track **One Take** is the first official song built into Sky Theft, playing on **Sky the Goat Radio**. Sky the Goat's YouTube channel also links to their **SoundCloud**.
Where can I listen to Sky the Goat's music?
Sky the Goat's YouTube channel (**sky thegoat**, @skythegoat999) links to their **SoundCloud**. You can also hear **One Take** in Sky Theft on **Sky the Goat Radio**. Hold **Q** for the radio wheel.
What websites does Sky the Goat have?

The official websites I know of:

- **skytheft.net**: the official Sky Theft website, with downloads, build notes, cars, weapons, the trainer and bug reports
- **skycreatorpro.com**: Sky Creator Pro, the free video editor and thumbnail maker

And the YouTube channel: youtube.com/@skythegoat999
What is Sky the Goat's YouTube channel?

Sky the Goat's YouTube channel is **sky thegoat**, at **youtube.com/@skythegoat999**. The channel description sums it up: *music artist, rapper, gamer, plays games like Fortnite, making music*. It has 200+ videos, including:

- **Sky Theft**: the Official Trailer #1 and an Alpha 0.5 full gameplay showcase
- **GTA San Andreas**: a Definitive Edition playthrough series
- **GTA mods**: Ferrari and Lamborghini mods, and Sky's own 4K texture pack
- **Minecraft**: a series where every death makes the Minecraft version older
- **Garry's Mod** memes
- **Sky Creator Pro**: Sky's own video editor and AI creator software
What's Sky the Goat's YouTube handle?
It's **@skythegoat999**. The channel name is **sky thegoat**: youtube.com/@skythegoat999
What videos does Sky the Goat make?

Sky the Goat makes gaming and creator videos, like:

- **Sky Theft | Official Trailer #1 - Open Beta Available Now**
- **Sky Theft Alpha 0.5 – Full Gameplay Showcase + Playable Build Now Available**
- **Minecraft every single time my Minecraft version Older (EP1)**, where every death sends the game to an older version
- **Built My Own AI Creator Software... Sky Creator Pro**
- **Sky Creator Pro Prototype - My New FREE Video Editor & Thumbnail Maker**
- **GTA San Andreas 4K Texture Pack v0.1 & v0.2 Showcase! | Work in Progress**
- **I Added Ferrari & Lamborghini Mods to OG GTA San Andreas PC**
- **CJ GOT DRIP! | GTA San Andreas #4**
- **GTA San Andreas Definitive Edition EP 3 | Drive-Thru & Gym!**
- **Garry's Mod Memes - NO WAY! I Actually Crashed Garry's Mod... Too Many Boats**
What GTA videos has Sky the Goat made?

Sky the Goat has a bunch of GTA San Andreas videos:

- A **GTA San Andreas Definitive Edition** playthrough, like *EP 3 | Drive-Thru & Gym!* and *CJ GOT DRIP! | GTA San Andreas #4*
- **I Added Ferrari & Lamborghini Mods to OG GTA San Andreas PC**
- **GTA San Andreas 4K Texture Pack v0.1 & v0.2 Showcase! | Work in Progress**, Sky's own texture pack

Check them out at youtube.com/@skythegoat999.
What is Sky the Goat's Minecraft series?

It's a challenge series on the sky thegoat channel: **every single time Sky dies, the Minecraft version goes older**. Episode 1 is in Minecraft Java Edition. It's a fun challenge because older versions are missing newer blocks, mobs and features, so each death changes the game.
Does Sky the Goat make GTA mods?

Yes! Sky the Goat has shown a **GTA San Andreas 4K texture pack** (v0.1 and v0.2, a work in progress) and made a video adding **Ferrari and Lamborghini mods to the original GTA San Andreas on PC**. Sky the Goat also made the **Max Power Trainer V4** mod for Sky Theft.
What is Sky the Goat's GTA San Andreas texture pack?

It's a **4K texture pack** Sky the Goat is making for GTA San Andreas, showcased on YouTube as **v0.1 and v0.2 (work in progress)**. It upgrades the game's textures to much higher resolution. Watch the showcase on the sky thegoat channel.
What happened in Sky the Goat's Garry's Mod video?

In *Garry's Mod Memes - NO WAY! I Actually Crashed Garry's Mod... Too Many Boats*, Sky the Goat spawned so many boats that Garry's Mod actually crashed. Too many physics props at once can overload the game's physics engine.
How do I support Sky the Goat?

Here's how you can support Sky the Goat:

1. **Subscribe** on YouTube: youtube.com/@skythegoat999
2. **Play Sky Theft** (free beta at skytheft.net) and report bugs
3. **Join the Sky Theft Discord**, linked on skytheft.net
4. **Listen to Sky's music** on SoundCloud, linked on the channel
5. **Try Sky Creator Pro** at skycreatorpro.com
6. **Share** the videos and the game with friends
Where is the Sky Theft trailer?
**Sky Theft | Official Trailer #1 - Open Beta Available Now** is on the sky thegoat YouTube channel (@skythegoat999), and it's also on skytheft.net under *See it in motion*.
What is Sky Creator Pro?

**Sky Creator Pro** is a free creator app made by Sky the Goat: a **video editor and thumbnail maker** for YouTubers and creators. It's a Windows desktop app plus a website (skycreatorpro.com) where you create an account and download it. Core editing is **free forever**, with no locked basic editing tools.
What can Sky Creator Pro do?

Sky Creator Pro can:

- **Edit videos on a timeline**: import media, trim clip starts and ends, split at the playhead, change speed, rename, duplicate and delete clips
- **Add text** to your videos
- **Undo and redo**
- **Export** at 1080p, or vertical 1080x1920 for Shorts
- **Make thumbnails**: pick a layout style, add your thumbnail text, and export
- **Save projects to the cloud** so you can keep editing later
- **Organize creator projects** on a dashboard

Sky the Goat has also shown AI creator tools, like an AI scheduler.
Is Sky Creator Pro free?

Yes. **Core editing in Sky Creator Pro stays free forever**, with no locked basic editing tools. There's an optional **Mega Pro** plan for future extras like AI tools, AI credits, cloud and project sync, and early access, but payments weren't live yet. It was in test mode with a free trial.
Where do I download Sky Creator Pro?
Go to **skycreatorpro.com**, create an account, and use the **Download** page to get Sky Creator Pro for Windows.
How do I edit a video in Sky Creator Pro?

1. Open the **Video Editor** and click **Import Media** to add your video.
2. Click a clip on the timeline to select it.
3. **Trim** the start or end, or move the playhead and **Split at playhead**.
4. Change the **speed**, **rename**, **duplicate** or **delete** clips as needed.
5. Click **Add Text** for titles or captions.
6. Choose export settings (resolution and frame rate) and click **Start Export**.

Save your project to the cloud first if you want to keep editing later.
How do I make a thumbnail in Sky Creator Pro?

Open the **thumbnail** tool in Sky Creator Pro, choose a **layout style**, type your **thumbnail text**, add your image, then click **Export Thumbnail**. Tips: use 3 to 5 big words, a close-up face or the main subject, and high contrast colors so it pops on YouTube.
Can Sky Creator Pro make YouTube Shorts?
Yes. Sky Creator Pro can export **vertical 1080x1920** video, the right size for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Reels.
What is Sky Creator Pro made with?

Sky Creator Pro is built with **React**, **TypeScript** and **Vite** for the interface, **Electron** for the Windows desktop app, **Supabase** for accounts and cloud storage, and **Netlify** for the website.
What is Mega Pro in Sky Creator Pro?

**Mega Pro** is an optional upgrade plan for Sky Creator Pro, for future AI tools, AI credits, cloud and project sync, and early access. It was in **test mode** with payments not live yet. Core editing stays free either way.
What is Sky AI Ultra?

**Sky AI Ultra** is the desktop app you use to chat with me, Sky AI. Sky the Goat made it. It runs entirely on your own PC and GPU, streams my answers live, keeps your chat history, and lets me run commands on your computer, but only when you click **Run**.
How do I open Sky AI Ultra?

Double-click **start_sky_ai.bat** in the sky-ai folder. The first time, it installs everything and trains me. After that, it opens the Sky AI Ultra window straight away and only retrains when the training data changes.
Does Sky AI need the internet?

No, not to chat. I run on your own PC's graphics card. The internet is only needed the first time, to download the AI model and the software. If you ask me to open a website, that needs internet of course.
How do I teach Sky AI new things?

Add examples to the **data** folder in the sky-ai project. Each line in a `.jsonl` file is one conversation, like this:

```json
{"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What is Sky Burger?"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "Sky Burger is a restaurant in Darkwood."}]}
```

Then double-click **start_sky_ai.bat**. It notices the data changed and retrains me automatically.
Can Sky AI get smarter?

Yes! By default Sky AI uses a small, fast model. For a smarter but slower version, train with `python train.py --ultra`. That uses the bigger **Qwen3-4B** model, and it still fits an 8 GB graphics card like the RTX 4060. More training examples in the data folder also make me know more.
